**Plugin version**
Confirm that the issue still occurs with the newest available version.

**Obsidian and platform**
Provide the Obsidian version and operating system. For local-service commands, include the Video2Knowledge version without sharing its configuration or credentials.

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Video source**
Provide a public YouTube or Bilibili URL only when it is safe to share. Do not post private links, API keys, cookies, tokens, local file paths, or note contents.

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Additional context**
Add relevant context and sanitized error text. State whether the direct YouTube command or local-service command was used.
